name: SHAI MISHALI
bio: Shai Mishali is a Senior iOS Tech Lead for monday.com, as well as an international speaker, and a highly active open-source contributor. He is also maintainer on several high-profile projects – namely, the RxSwift Community and RxSwift projects, but he also releases many open-source endeavours around Combine such as CombineCocoa, RxCombine and more.
